top_signals.title: Regal's Poman Lo On Green Investing
top_signals.summary: Poman Lo, Founder of One Earth Summit and Vice Chairman and Managing Director at Regal Hotels Group, discusses her push for sustainability and the opportunities she sees in student housing. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Hong Kong's Kevin Choi on Innovation
top_signals.summary: Kevin Choi, Permanent Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry at the Hong Kong SAR Government, says the city needs to expand its real economy beyond the financial sector, with innovation becoming a second engine of growth. He speaks exclusively on the sidelines of the One Earth Summit in Hong Kong. (Source: Bloomberg)
